questions.stem: A runner completes one full lap of a 400 m track, finishing where they started. What is their displacement?
questions.explanation: Displacement is the straight-line distance from start to finish. Since the runner returns to their starting point, the displacement is 0 m, even though the distance covered is 400 m.

questions.stem: Which statement about distance and displacement is correct?

options.text: Displacement can be greater than distance
Distance is always greater than or equal to the magnitude of displacement

questions.explanation: Distance measures the total path length and is always greater than or equal to the magnitude of displacement. Distance can only equal displacement when motion is in a straight line without changing direction.
